notes.title: Patch Notes for 04/12/2024
notes.content:
[b]v2.2.3.32893[/b]

[h2]Balancing[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]Common[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Resolution “Portfolio Scrutiny”[/b] (apply to all) rework : Cannot buy CHOAM Shares and Selling CHOAM Shares gives [b]3 Hegemony[/b] per Shares instead of Solaris
[*] [b]Resolution “CHOAM Dilution”[/b] (apply to all) rework : [b]20% of owned CHOAM[/b] Shares are destroyed
[*] [b]Resolution “Sale Incentive”[/b] (targeted) rework : [b]10%[/b] and [b]30%[/b] CHOAM ownership bonus are blocked for the duration, and at the start of next council, lost [b]20 solari[/b] per shares owned 
[*] [b]Resolution “Labor Right”[/b] (apply to all) rework : [b]+100%[/b] military unit upkeep
[*] [b]Resolution “Imperial Intelligence”[/b], which allows to use Cell Search outside of an assassination attempt, now also [b]block the installation of new Infiltration Cell[/b] for the duration.
[*] the immediate effect on price of selling or buying a shares is [b]50%[/b] stronger
[*] [b]sietches now have an integrated missile battery[/b] that will only target flying units engaged in combat with their militia
[*] flying units can no longer trigger the attack on a sietch[/list]
[h3]Factions[/h3]
[expand type=showmore expanded=true][h3]Atreides[/h3][expand type=showmore]
[list][*] [b]Duncan Idaho has been reworked:[/b]
[*] for each bonus given by an ally unit, [b]gains heroism[/b] ([b]+2[/b] power ; [b]+1[/b] armor)
[*] upon death, all future Duncans gains[b] +3 power[/b] and [b]+150 health[/b]
[*] “Duncan’s Last Stand” skill is now a toggle with the following effects:
[list][*] enemy ground units in melee suffer [b]-50%[/b] speed
[*] [b]+100%[/b] speed
[*] [b]+100%[/b] attack speed
[*] keep all your heroism stacks
[*] cannot be controlled
[*] cannot be turned off while duncan is still engaged in melee[/list]
[*] Trooper gear “Offensive Mindset” has been reworked. It now gives [b]+2[/b] power and increase damage received by [b]+15%[/b]
[*] Heavy Weapon Squad gear “Distracting Flashes” reduces damage received 
[*] by ally around the target by [strike]20%[/strike] -> [b]10%[/b], but no longer removes any power
[*] The Heavy Weapon Squad “Distorsion Umbrella” gear has been replaced by “Whistling Ammo” 
[*] Support Drone gear “Kraken Protocol” removes [strike]2[/strike] -> [b]1[/b] armor when the drone is empty.
[*] Support Drone gear “Evasion Booster” no longer requires [b]+1[/b] fuel cell
[*] Warden gear “Cover Tactics” gives [strike]+2[/strike] -> [b]+5 [/b]armor to ally with no target, at short range.[/list][/expand]
[h3]Smugglers[/h3][expand type=showmore]
[list][*] [b]Lashon Hara[/b] gives [strike]2[/strike] -> [b]1[/b] influence production per infiltration level in another faction
[*] Wrecker gear “Concentrated Toxins” gives [strike]+50%[/strike] -> [b]+75%[/b] damage to the target
[*] Wrecker gear “Traumatic Repeater” now removes [b]1[/b] more armor to any damaged target, no matter how many health they have.
[*] Wrecker gear “Stinging Gas” no longer removes [b]1[/b] power
[*] The Sniper gear “Distorsion Umbrella” gear has been replaced by “Barrel Cleaner” (previously seen on Ecaz Musketeer)[/list][/expand]
[h3]Fremen[/h3][expand type=showmore]
[list][*] [b]Jamis[/b] gives [strike]80[/strike] -> [b]70[/b] authority on liberation
[*] Stilgar gives [b]+1[/b] authority production, instead of reducing sietch alliance authority cost by half
[*] Shimoom gives [b]+4[/b] plascrete production per village producing [b]12[/b] Water or more, on top of his other effects.
[*] Fedaykin have [strike]21[/strike] -> [b]22[/b] power
[*] Warrior gear “Dry Training” has been reworked. It now gives [b]+1[/b] health per Water.
[*] Infiltrator gear “Focused Mind” gives [b]+1[/b] armor on top of its other effect.[/list][/expand]
[h3]Corrino[/h3][expand type=showmore]
[list][*]Corrino [b]10k[/b] hegemony bonus no longer gives influence for militia killed in a territory in truce. It still works on neutral units from a raid, and enemy units.[/list][/expand]
[h3]Ecaz[/h3][expand type=showmore]
[list][*] Fencers have [strike]10[/strike] -> [b]11[/b] power and get [strike]-30%[/strike] -> [b]-40%[/b] damage received from target
[*] Sirens give [strike]-10%[/strike] -> [b]-15%[/b] damage to next attack" to enemies they damage with their aoe
[*] Museum of Unbound Arts gives [strike]+3[/strike] -> [b]+4[/b] max authority, influence and manpower per masterpieces
[*] Warbanner gear “Distracting Lights” makes unit targeting the war banner inflict [strike]-20%[/strike] -> [b]-30%[/b] damage
[*] Warbanner gear “Propaganda Machine” has been reworked. It now reduces the damage inflicted by enemy units at range by [b]10%[/b]
[*] Warbanner gear “Big Banner” gives[strike] +300[/strike] -> [b]+100[/b] health, but does not increase Command Points requirements anymore.[/list][/expand]
[h3]Vernius[/h3][expand type=showmore]
[list][*] Resonance Drone’s electrostatic damages affected enemies by[strike] 100[/strike] -> [b]120[/b] health per day.
[*] Fighting Mek gear “Material preprocessor” gives [strike]+3%[/strike] ->[b]+5%[/b] power but removes [strike]3%[/strike] -> [b]5%[/b] attack speed per armor points on the target
[*] Fighting Mek gear “Anatomical Scanner” gives [strike]+20%[/strike] -> [b]+15%[/b] damage against non mechanical units
[*] Railgun Drone gear “Warm Magnet” is replaced by “Strong Magnet”, which gives [b]+3[/b] power but increases fuel cell requirement by [b]2[/b]
[*] Fighting Meks and Railgun Drones gear “Smart Armor” and “Smart Lens” have been replaced by “Learning Transistor”, which gives [b]+0.5[/b] Knowledge while tethered in combat
[*] Suboid gear “Focused Mind” gives [b]+1[/b] armor on top of its usual effect.
[*] Resonance drone has [b]4[/b] fully reworked gears :
[list][*] “Fractal Frequencies” : The electrostatic deals [b]+50%[/b] damage and requires [b]+2[/b] Fuel Cell
[*] “Feedback Gate” : [b]+0.5[/b] armor per ally drone at range
[*] “Deep Signales” : ally drones at range deal [b]+10%[/b] damage
[*] “Repeater Node” : Always tethered ; Drones at range are tethered[/list]
[*] Fight Engineer gear “Whistling Ammo” has been replaced by “Multi-Purpose Parts”, which gives [b]-20%[/b] solari upkeep and regeneration cost to drones at range[/list][/expand][/expand]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list][*] Vernius Fighting Meks and Railgun Drones get the trooper and sniper icons respectively
[*] during landsraad, in multiplayer:
[list][*] in "fast" event timer, preliminary phases will last up to [strike]20[/strike] -> [b]30[/b] seconds each, and voting phase will last up to [strike]30[/strike] -> [b]45[/b] seconds
[*] in "slow" event timer, preliminary phases will last up to [strike]2 min[/strike] -> [b]1 min 30[/b], and voting phase will last up to [strike]10[/strike] -> [b]5[/b] minutes[/list]
[*] “Slow” landsraad is now the default setting in multiplayer.
[*] The Recon time of POI now has a maximum. It will reduce the time to recon poi that are very far away from the Main Base[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2][hr][/hr]
[list][*] When placing rally point as a fremen, the correct range is now showed
[*] The right character will now address the player during the “Hired Help” mission, in Fremen and Smuggler conquest.
[*] The “Cutting the Head Off” mission will now properly check the infiltration level of the right opponent
[*] Fixing a bug with overflowing spice, affecting the “Spice Heist” conquest mission
[*] The “Spice Heist” conquest mission can no longer happen against Vernius, making it almost impossible to succeed.
[*] Fixing the Accursed Sietch sometimes not appearing in “The Water Thieves” conquest mission
[*] Some memory leaks plugged
[*] Some crashes fixed[/list]

notes.title: Dune: Spice Wars - Community Update #4 Out Now!
notes.content:
[quote]Hello everyone!

Community Update #4 is now live! This update includes new content and balancing changes all inspired by your feedback and suggestions. 

Check out the full list of changes below and let us know what you think. We’re excited to hear your feedback![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/17f0b9087bed33e6e9372ce0ea473ccae78938ed.png[/img]

[h2]New Conquests[/h2]
Smugglers and Fremen are now playable in the Conquest game mode. The Fremen conquest brings a unique twist, focusing on the liberation of the planet rather than the traditional Conquest gameplay. You can also engage in three new battles, with two exclusively available in the Fremen Conquest and one accessible in the Smugglers Conquest. Additionally, there are seven new achievements to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/490e7b75c9d759028d291e17e75b2caf4758572c.png[/img]

[h2]New Map Types[/h2]
Six new map types are now available for both single-player and multiplayer modes, each offering unique challenges and strategic possibilities.

In Skirmish mode:
[list][*] Dune Small, Medium, and Large are the standard maps, each representing different sizes of the northern hemisphere of Arrakis. 
[*] The Great Flat map is a vast expanse with extensive Deep Desert, placing main bases far from each other and emphasizing the importance of mobility and water. Expanding on the Great Flat is challenging due to the large distances between regions. 
[*] The Populous Basin is another large map featuring numerous small regions, ideal for building strong defensive clusters of villages. Here, main bases are placed close to each other near the center of the map, allowing for outward expansion. 
[*] Great Erg is a medium-sized map filled with smaller Deep Deserts and Mountain regions, creating bottlenecks and regions of strategic importance. 
[*] Desert Ridge, designed for 2v2 play, is an elongated map where each team starts at opposite ends, separated by a long ridge and several Deep Desert areas. 
[*] Sandy Valley is a medium rectangular map centered around a valley, well-suited for both 2v2 and free-for-all matches.[/list]
In Kanly mode:
[list][*] The Standard Kanly map covers the northern hemisphere of Arrakis
[*] Narrow Pass map is smaller and filled with Mountain regions and bottlenecks, adding tactical complexity to each encounter.[/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/d03e1294949445efb245a04d5f1ba737655308db.png[/img]

[h2]Statistics Screen[/h2]
New “Statistics” screen in the main menu, which includes detailed information on your performance with each faction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/36dc5936ff96bbba0d95acd157ad8e8fe20054cb.png[/img]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[h3]Conquest[/h3]
[list][*] The “Water Gift” secondary objective has been reworked to be slightly more challenging.
[*] It takes 8 -> 10 controlled territory to validate the conquest objective, in great houses conquests.
[*] “Spying Initiative” bonus gives +5 -> +2 max agents.[/list]
[h3]Common[/h3]
[list][*] The “Insider Trading” development gives 1 -> 2 influence per share sold and removes CHOAM selling cooldown and max influence during the landsraad council.
[*] It is now possible to steal a nuclear warhead by annexing the village where the silo is built.
[*] 30% CHOAM bonus gives +100 -> +200 max influence.
[*] The resolution “Landsraad Support” gives 2 -> 5 landsraad punishers.
[*] The resolution “Spacing Guild Resources” gives +20 -> +10 armor to affected Main Bases.[/list]
[h3]Atreides[/h3]
[list][*] Rangers have 1 -> 0 armor and 18 -> 17 power.
[*] Heavy Weapon Squads have 1 -> 0 armor.
[*] Gurney gives +5% attack speed per level to ranged units instead of +1 armor
[*] Gurney does not reduce the attack speed of his target anymore.[/list]
[h3]Harkonnen[/h3]
[list][*] Iakin Nefud rework:
[list][*] When Iakin reach 0 health, he steals the health of an ally ground unit at short range, instead of dying.
[*] Any unit death at short range gives +1 power and +0.5 armor.
[*] “Cannon fodder” skill: 
[list][*] Level 1 ally unit at short range permanently becomes Cannon Fodder, and suffers the following effects:
[*] Loses 10% of health every day.
[*] Cannot regenerate health in villages or gain experience.
[*] No Solari upkeep, and no Command Point requirements.
[*] Half of the unit cost is refunded upon death in combat.[/list][/list][/list]
[h3]Smugglers[/h3]
[list][*] Main Base Extension “Hidden Explosives” no longer reduces the main base armor, instead it makes it unable to attack for a day.
[*] The “Bounty” resolution modifier gives 20 -> 10 solari per vote placed on a resolution.
[*] Lashon Hara gives 1 infiltration level in a faction every time a successful trade takes palce with that faction.
[*] Lashon Hara produces 10 -> 15 solari and 1 -> 2 influence par infiltration level in another faction
[*] Staban no longer gives any solari.[/list]
[h3]Fremen[/h3]
[list][*] During Wormriding, sandworm moves at a speed of 15 -> 25.
[*] Jamis trades 10 authority for 10 -> 30 manpower.[/list]
[h3]Corrino[/h3]
[list][*] Irulan rework: Every building can be constructed one more time anywhere on the map.[/list]
[h3]Ecaz[/h3]
[list][*] Can break truce, with a +100% penalty on standing loss and no damage bonus.
[*] Perfected units cost +50% -> +100% but take +100% -> +50 % longer to recruit.
[*] Perfected units now cost 100% more to heal.
[*] Whitmore skill consumes Champion’s Trophy every 5 -> 4 seconds.
[*] Can no longer build its Garden in a region where hostile units are present. Building the Garden also interrupts any unit that had the order to attack it.[/list]
[h3]Vernius[/h3]
[list][*] With the development “Automated Defense”, Neural Node attacks with an attack speed of 10 -> 6.6.

notes.title: Dune: Spice Wars - Community Update #3 Out Now!
notes.content:
[quote]Hello everyone!

Community Update #3 is now live! This update includes several reworks and balancing changes all inspired by your feedback and suggestions. The standout feature? Our brand-new spectator mode!

Check out the full list of changes below and let us know what you think. We’re excited to hear your feedback on these latest improvements![/quote]

[h2]Spectator Mode[/h2]
Multiplayer lobbies can be set up to allow up to 8 spectators.

Eliminated players can keep watching the game as spectators.

[h2]Pillaged Sietch rework[/h2]
Fremen can no longer build in a devastated sietch. They can, however, repopulate them for a large cost, which removes the “devastated” trait.

To compensate, Fremen now have 1 more building slot in their Main Base, forming a new 1-slot district.

The eligibility condition for Dune Governorship has also been revised to only account for non-devastated sietches. The condition is now:
[list][*] control 1/5 of the map
[*] ally all non-devastated sietches
[*] at least 3/4 of sietches are not devastated[/list]

[h2]Assassination UX rework[/h2]
Assassination UI has been improved with additional information on what you are supposed to do.

A new option “Assassination tips” will help with learning the Assassination mechanics through targeted alerts. The option is “on” by default.

The “imperial intelligence” Landsraad resolution, that allows Cell Search, even without having detected any assassination attempt, now works properly: you can prepare Cell Search operations, but also use them on your territory.

[h2]Spaceship Balancing[/h2]
All spaceship costs, stats and traits have been balanced to make them worth the cost, without being overwhelmingly strong.

Hawk:
[list][*] 30 -> 9 guild favor cost
[*] 15 -> 12 solari upkeep
[*] 200 -> 270 health
[*] 11 -> 8 power
[*] 10 -> 20 attack speed[/list]
Kraken:
[list][*] Can only attack ground units[/list]
Harpy:
[list][*] 30 -> 9 guild favor cost
[*] 15 -> 12 solari upkeep
[*] 200 -> 270 health
[*] 8 -> 10 power
[*] Trait changed to “attack in a small area and executes enemy units under 80 health”[/list]
Overlord:
[list][*] Can only attack ground units[/list]
Banshee:
[list][*] Can attack ground and air units
[*] 40 -> 15 guild favor cost
[*] 250 -> 360 health
[*] 25 -> 17 power
[*] 4 -> 5 Fuel Cell
[*] 4 -> 5 Command Point
[*] Trait changed to “Cannot be seen outside of combat and current target suffer -50% speed and attack speed”[/list]
Spire:
[list][*] Can attack ground and air units
[*] 20 -> 6 spaceship parts cost
[*] 80 -> 150 health
[*] 20 -> 8 power
[*] 5 -> 10 attack speed
[*] 10 -> 8 solari upkeep
[*] Trait changed to “+50% damage against enemy units outside of their territory”[/list]
Altar:
[list][*] Can only attack ground units[/list]
Hammer:
[list][*] 40 -> 12 guild favor cost
[*] 300 -> 360 health
[*] 20 -> 16 solari upkeep[/list]
Cronos:
[list][*] Can only attack air units
[*] 2000 -> 2400 health[/list]
Siren:
[list][*] 30 -> 9 guild favor
[*] 200 -> 270 health
[*] 24 -> 10 power
[*] 15 -> 12 solari upkeep
[*] Trait changed “attacks in a small area, and damaged enemy deal -10% damage on their next attack (can stack)”[/list]
Monument:
[list][*] Can only attack ground units[/list]
Spirit:
[list][*] 30 -> 9 guild favor
[*] 150 -> 270 health
[*] 15 -> 18 power
[*] 5 -> 3.3 attack speed
[*] 15 -> 12 solari upkeep
[*] Trait changed “always tethered and, in truced territory, gain stealth and -40% damage received”[/list]

[h2]General Balancing[/h2]
“Defense breaches” operations do not stack.

Main bases detect stealth units at Very Long Range.

Landsraad units from "Judge of the Council" Charter cost 40 -> 25 influence each to recruit.

“EMP Bomb” spying operation:
[list][*] -50% attack speed to mechanical units, missile battery and Main Bases
[*] -50% -> -20% move speed to mechanical units
[*] “-50% power to mechanical units” has been removed[/list]
Gear switching or removal cost 1000 -> 500 solari

Development “Border Defense”:
[list][*] +1 Missile Battery limit per Village
[*] Militia have +2 -> +1 armor
[*] “+30% power to Missile Battery” has been removed[/list]
Main Base building “Research Center”:
[list][*] +20% knowledge
[*] +20% hegemony gained from spice tax and daily gain
[*] “+15% hegemony from all sources” has been removed[/list]
AI in multiplayer games never offer trades outside of their team, and are generally more reluctant to accept trades.

[h2]House Atreides[/h2]
Trooper unit:
[list][*] Trait changed: ”+2 -> +3 power under the effect of at least one allied bonus”[/list]
Ranger gear “Automated Weapons”:
[list][*] +50% attack speed
[*] -25% -> -30% power[/list]
Support Drone:
[list][*] 15 -> 12 solari upkeep[/list]
“Peaceful Annex” is no longer possible on devastated villages.

"Veteran Militia" development:
[list][*] -15% damage inside territory
[*] militia have +100% -> +80% health
[*] “militia have +50% power” has been removed[/list]
"Proud Liberator" development:
[list][*] Non-mechanical units get +2% -> +1% max health per 25 -> 20 standing
[*] Units liberating or annexing a village from a faction with less standing heal 20% -> 50% of health for free[/list]
"Sustainable spying" development:
[list][*] Agents assigned to choam, landsraad and spacing guild slots produce +100% -> +50% of their associated resources
[*] Agent traits present only once on an information field apply their effects twice[/list]
Councilor “Dr Wellington Yueh”:
[list][*] +2 knowledge
[*] non-mechanical military units have +10% -> +15% health
[*] non mechanical military units regen 30% faster[/list]

[h2]House Harkonnen[/h2]
Combat Probe:
[list][*] 5 -> 4 solari upkeep[/list]
Councilor “Umman Kudu”:
[list][*] +2 manpower prod
[*] units take -20% -> -30% time to recruit
[*] units in a region with an active harkonnen operation gain +1 armor[/list]
Hero “Iakin Nefud”:
[list][*] Military units in the region get +5% -> +10% attack speed per active harkonnen operation
[*] “Survival of the Fittest” skill gives +100% -> +200% power to the next attack, which only stacks once, but has a much lower cooldown.[/list]

[h2]The Smugglers[/h2]

[list][*] full headquarter produce 5 -> 4 solari per neighboring headquarters
[*] +1 slot in headquarter[/list]

[list][*] produces 10 -> 12 Water
[*] unlock the Water Network and Water Seller headquarters extension[/list]

[list][*] gain information in other faction by trading any resources
[*] information level in faction reduce 50% slower
[*] gain 10 solari and 1 influence per information level in another faction[/list]

[h2]The Fremen[/h2]
Skirmisher:
[list][*] 7 -> 5 power
[*] Trait: +15%->20% damage per enemy unit in damage radius[/list]
Mobile turrets now have xp.

Balancing of spaceship parts looted from enemy vessels. Combined with cost changes, Spire are overall cheaper to produce from destroyed enemy ships.

Councilor “Shimoom”:
[list][*] Each village producing at least 12 Water gives -3% -> -4% solari upkeep globally
[*] Villages produce 1 water in empty slot[/list]
Councilor “Jamis”:
[list][*] gain 50 -> 80 authority on liberating an enemy village
[*] military unit inflict +10% damage outside of territory
[*] can trade authority for manpower[/list]
Councillor Mother Ramallo’s ability “Incite rebellion” cost 80 -> 50 authority

[h2]House Corrino[/h2]
Artillery Drone:
[list][*] 25 -> 20 solari upkeep[/list]
Councilor “Princess Irulan” now only affects villages neighboring a main base

Councilor “Zum Garon”:
[list][*] Military units have +15% power per active Truce
[*] Imperial Mandate has no cost[/list]

[h2]House Ecaz[/h2]
War Banner:
[list][*] 15 -> 12 solari upkeep
[*] The “Big Banner” gear now increases the banner range of effect.[/list]
Hero “Whitmore Bludd”:
[list][*] If multiple champions deal damage to the same unit, only the last to damage it will get a trophy
[*] the “Frightful Champion” skill gives +1 -> +0.5 armor per trophy[/list]
Councillor Ibbo Vipp’s ability “Landsraad Immunity” cost 20 -> 30 standing on negative resolution and gives 10 -> 30 influence on positive resolution

[h2]House Vernius[/h2]
Fighting Mek:
[list][*] 350 -> 400 health[/list]
Railgun Drone:
[list][*] 220 -> 320 health[/list]
Resonance Drone:
[list][*] 350 -> 400 health
[*] 25 -> 20 solari upkeep[/list]
10k Hegemony Bonus:
[list][*] Can obfuscate a single researched development
[*] Each knowledge point increase production of all other resource by +0.1 -> +0.2%[/list]
“Physical Wiring” development:
[list][*] Unlocks Assassins
[*] Infiltration Cells adjacent to a connected neural node gives +2 knowledge, as well as +5 solari production and +1 intel production per Statecraft building in the village
[*] “Infiltration cells adjacent to a connected neural node do not count in the maximum of infiltration cells allowed” has been removed[/list]
“Automated Defenses” development:
[list][*] 2 free Automated Militia in any village with a connected neural node
[*] Connected Neural Nodes attack enemy units in the region as a rapid-fire single-target defensive building.
[*] “enemy units in the region suffer -3% health per day per node connected through this region” has been removed[/list]

[h2]Lobby QoL[/h2]
[list][*] A player kicked from a lobby cannot join again for 1 minute.
[*] quick start can no longer be used in kanly, and the option is no longer visible[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list][*] Truces are no longer broken if the target of an attack (village) is captured by another faction before the attack takes place. 
[*] AoE damage no longer breaks truces unless the actual target is in a truce.
[*] Units are no longer eaten by a worm in a region protected by Decoy Thumper

notes.content:
[h2]Heroes[/h2]
The characters of Dune now walk the sands of Arrakis. 
After reaching 10k Hegemony, each faction can choose between 2 heroes to recruit as an unit that will influence their whole military strategy:
[list][*] House Atreides: Duncan Idaho or Gurney Halleck
[*] House Harkonnen: Glossu Rabban or Iakin Nefud
[*] The Fremen: Chani Kynes or Otheym
[*] House Corrino: Wensicia Corrino or Captain Aramsham
[*] The Smugglers: Drisq or Bannerjee
[*] House Ecaz: Whitmore Bludd or Ilesa Ecaz[/list]
When your hero dies in battle, you’ll be able to bring them back as a Ghola, if you’re willing to pay the cost to both your bank account and your reputation.

[h2]New councillors[/h2]
Heroes that were previously councilors have been replaced by two new councilors per faction:
[list][*] House Atreides: Dr. Wellington Yueh and Young Paul Atreides
[*] House Harkonnen: Umman Kudu and Cron Vatia
[*] The Smugglers: Lashon Hara and Stakkanov
[*] The Fremen: Jamis and Shimoom
[*] House Corrino: Mother Helen Gaius Mohiam and Zum Garon
[*] House Ecaz: Rivvy Dinari and Ibbo Vipp[/list]
[h2]Combat Rework[/h2]
[list][*] Combat systems have been reworked with an emphasis on making army composition deeper and more diverse, with every unit having a role to play, without increasing the need to micromanage too much.
[*] Units have a more diverse range of armor values. Armor can no longer be shredded, but every faction has a unit that reduces armor value by a flat amount, as well as a unit made to kill high-armored opponents.
[*] To increase diversity, units now have different attack speeds, and Elite units are available earlier in the game, at 5k hegemony. Gear are also more specialized and easier to access: they are free to install and only cost Solari to remove or swap.
[*] To increase the strategic possibilities, both on the offense and defense, it is now possible to change the position your units appear on the map by placing a Rally Point anywhere within Airfield range. The Fremen use allied sietches that have not been pillaged to place their Rally Point.
[*] To accommodate those changes, almost all units' stats, traits and gear have been changed, as well as many military buildings, development and operation.[/list]
[h2]Stealth Rework[/h2]
[list][*] We’ve made Stealth a more powerful, advanced mechanic.
[*] Stealthy units are no longer detected by everything. They will often remain hidden until their first strike in combat. To detect a stealthy unit before they strike, you will have to rely on Probe Setup, a new village building called Monitoring Station, or a rare Gear or Hero effect.
[*] On the other hand, most units are no longer stealth as a base effect. Most but not all of the units that were previously stealthy have a gear that grants the effect. It can otherwise be granted by some faction’s spying operation, development, or heroes.[/list]
[h2]Intel Mini-Rework[/h2]
To make intel, operation and faction infiltration more valuable we removed the production of 1 intel per non-faction information field. We also restricted Data Center to regions neighboring an enemy, like the Listening Post, and reworked the Observatory Mountain special region: it allows you to build both Data Center and Listening Post without constraint and increase their production by 50%.

[h2]House Vernius of Ix[/h2]
House Vernius of Ix can appear as an opposing faction in every game mode.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kgajYkMYh6QC1wzq8RQfmYiiNiTF7-svVo3t1nQmE0I/edit?usp=sharing

As always, let us know what you think of the new content! In the meantime, feel free to join our awesome (and passionate) community on our [url=https://discord.gg/JXvzteGMrY]Discord[/url] server, [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Dunespicewars/]Reddit[/url] page as well as [url=https://twitter.com/DuneSpiceWars]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Introducing: Heroes of Dune
notes.content:
[h1]Heroes[/h1]
The main purpose of Heroes of Dune is to introduce even more of the Dune universe into the game. We already had a healthy amount of Dune characters in the game (31 characters in total), but they were only present in interfaces. Heroes of Dune will bring some of them in flesh onto the map, alongside your military units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/f57c73423cd32de9b7e095a108df461918ece73a.gif[/img]

Prominent figures of the Dune universe like Duncan Idaho and Glossu Rabban will be playable units in every game mode, and will have a tremendous impact on the battlefield.

The heroes are:
[list][*] Duncan Idaho and Gurney Halleck for House Atreides
[*] Glossu Rabban and Iakin Nefud for House Harkonnen
[*] Drisq and Bannerjee for The Smugglers
[*] Chani Kynes and Otheym for The Fremen
[*] Aramsham and Wensicia Corrino for House Corrino
[*] Ilesa Ecaz and Whitmore Bludd for House Ecaz[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/5be7d3d1023753d482cbb85545033f3c68cd0af1.gif[/img]

All heroes have been redesigned compared to the version currently in conquest. They are designed to have a significant impact on the military orientation of the faction. They all have a global effect, several more localized effects, and an active skill. They are more complex units than the other units in the game.

[h1]Councillors[/h1]
All heroes were previously councillors. Heroes and councillors are now distinct entities, which means that each faction has "lost" two councillors. To compensate, we will add two councillors to each faction (for a total of 50 named characters from the Dune universe in the game, including the DLC House Vernius of Ix).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/d92c6ce45889acbbbe91b8e86381ce8795259824.png[/img]

[h1]Combat Rework[/h1]
We have revamped the combat system and all units in the game with the following objectives in mind:
[list][*] Make army composition richer and deeper by ensuring that all units have a place / a role in the army.
[*] Direct military micro-management towards positioning at the moment of engagement rather than micro-control of units during combat.
[*] Make gear more fun and unique.
[*] Slightly simplify combat onboarding with simpler basic unit traits.[/list]

As always, let us know what you think of the upcoming content! In the meantime, feel free to join our awesome (and passionate) community on our [url=https://discord.gg/JXvzteGMrY]Discord[/url] server, [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Dunespicewars/]Reddit[/url] page as well as [url=https://twitter.com/DuneSpiceWars]Twitter[/url].

Community Update #2 has arrived on Arrakis! As usual, the changes are based on community feedback/sentiments, read on to find out more...[/quote]

notes.title: Dune: Spice Wars - Community Update #1 Out Now!
notes.content:
[quote]Hey Everyone!

Community Update #1 is now live! With this update, we have made a number of changes based entirely on the feedback and suggestions of our players since our launch out of early access!

Check out the full list of changes below…[/quote]

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
The game is now fully playable with a controller, crossplay with XBOX is supported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/fa08faaa3b79e0888468047baebae1c922d5b9b4.png[/img]

The wheel menu has been added to provide a seamless experience for controller users. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/3e61b22b0d0690c4eb34e64ba169ee6abf11a9be.png[/img]

[h2]Keyword Tooltip[/h2]
It’s now possible to hover over most keywords to open a tooltip, a much-requested feature..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/bb7c59222f14aa20c5f12303afe547a3dccc6368.png[/img]

[h2]Landsraad Rework[/h2]
To make the Landsraad council less of a strain on your attention, we’ve condensed it into a single event that happens every 20 days. It puts the whole game on pause, and contains every landsraad phase in short succession.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/4016f7c593cf5441a473e3498bcb44f5acf6e1b8.png[/img]

[h3]Other important changes to the Landsraad Council:[/h3]
To make strategy involving Charters less subject to luck, we added a new system: Charter Priority, letting players choose which Charter will appear on the ballot thanks to their influence.
We added many new resolutions and improved the way they were picked to make the proposed resolutions more relevant to current situation.
We improved the visual representation of political power, and voting results, as well as a tutorial for the Landsraad Council.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/45552689eb02c9aff073c6c8ea43077537de1911.png[/img]

[h2]Harvester rework[/h2]
Harvesters no longer require to be manually deployed. To keep the thematic element of risk/reward involved in Spice Harvesting, they now have two modes: Greed Mode and Safe Mode
Safe Mode is only available with an ornithopter attached.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/c1bec9ad59c6b0c20a9fcc7600e57a19f131ae91.png[/img]

[h2]Conquest[/h2]
Many Atreides, Harkonnen and Corrino bonuses have been reworked to be more enjoyeable & fun. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/173c0f3c591b52a5580b067c9186968859cc8c8a.png[/img]

[h2]Main Base Buildings[/h2]
We've added 3 new Main Base Buildings: Recycling Vats, Fusion Plant and Landsraad Quarters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/e20c217f238580eac2c2237c61bc57e1c7d15c31.png[/img]

[h2]Water Balancing[/h2]
The development that unlocked the “windtraps” building felt mandatory in the previous patch, which is why we removed it completely: “Windtraps” are now exclusive to the Fremen. “Dew collectors” have been balanced accordingly, and new avenues of Water production have been added.

[b]Full changelog here[/b] - https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QmWNzn2EZRnSK6aSaGYouYr_FQ6OErj1FFhZtxvY8NI/edit?usp=sharing 

[quote]Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions, we can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback on this update!

Enjoy the update and stay tuned for news about what's next for Dune: Spice Wars!

- Shiro Games[/quote]

[quote]The Dune: Spice Wars 1.0 update has finally landed on Arrakis, and with it has come an absolute plethora of new content, reworks, fixes and more! 

The last year and a half has seen multiple updates release, adding tons of content, improvements and more, largely built on the suggestions and feedback of our players. So thank you to everyone who has supported us and helped us build Dune: Spice Wars into what it is today over the course of the Early Access period. We literally couldn't have done it without you!

But with all the sentimental stuff out of the way, let's take a look at what's new in Dune: Spice Wars' 1.0 update...

[/quote]

[i](Please Note: This is a slightly abridged version of the patch notes, for the full list of changes check out the document [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yjd1HlUXVF0plLlAPKSPA176uPMO0juZH3I_-ozy1lw/edit?usp=sharing]HERE[/url])[/i]

notes.title: Dune: Spice Wars - Early Access Recap
notes.content:
[quote] It's been a long year and a half for Dune: Spice Wars, with Early Access seeing the arrival of numerous updates bringing new factions, multiplayer battles, system overhauls, new biomes, systems, features and so much more to the game before leading us here: just 2 days away from our launch out of Early Access and into 1.0!

So in this article we're going to take a look back at all of the major updates that have come to the game over the course of the Early Access campaign and remind you of anything you might have missed! [/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/404c5ff071abfc37cc97d015284dbad6efe66c81.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/f7539bbfb333909ed46de8929f6cb332ab6bb296.png[/img]

Dune: Spice Wars first update after launching into Early Access "[b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1605220/announcements/detail/3226278286753805586?snr=2_9_100003_]Community Update #1[/url][/b]" was led mostly by community feedback and suggestions, bringing new faction-specific bonuses, an improved queue system, and immersive combat views. Players were given the opportunity to explore new regions, expand their Underworld Headquarters, and enjoyed a more balanced and polished gaming experience, allowing us to get to work on our first major content update… 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/31ff2231aaa5a0b5c08e7fd8a5894cedff584e67.jpg[/img]

In the highly anticipated [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1605220/announcements/detail/3334366421569375901?snr=2_9_100003_]Multiplayer Update[/url][/b], we invited players to join forces in 2v2 matches or engage in intense free-for-alls with up to four players, commanding the Atreides, Harkonnen, Fremen, or Smugglers. 

But that's not all. We completely revamped every development tree, emphasising synergy between factions, and added an array of new political resolutions, events, regions, and a slew of other improvements. Our aim was to fully realise the universe and themes of Dune, delivering an experience of grand machinations, subtle political plotting, and epic reversals. With multiplayer, the potential for these grand narratives soared as players vied for dominance in every stage of war.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/47e8a336900aeced6d819e27f5331399f8c20b8f.png[/img]

In our second [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1605220/announcements/detail/3407554354308648749?snr=2_9_100003_]community update[/url][/b], the Spice tax system was reworked, balancing the game dynamics across factions, while Fremen received a starting supply boost. Unit movement and military supply consumption were optimized, and stealth units became day-night cycle-sensitive.

Balancing efforts mixed up numerous unit stats, Command Points, and more. Development trees underwent a massive overhaul, along with revisions to spying missions, resolutions, and agent traits.

Multiplayer introduced 'Kanly' mode, bringing a faster experience in a 1v1 setting, while quality-of-life improvements, visual enhancements, and bug fixes refined the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/c7cc8fb21231ed446bdddbc9382d76e5625725e5.png[/img]

The introduction of the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1605220/announcements/detail/3390670295075611184?snr=2_9_100003_]House Corrino Update[/url][/b] to Dune: Spice Wars was a game-changer, bringing the illustrious Imperial House Corrino into the fray. Led by Shaddam IV, House Corrino's arrival marked a significant milestone in the game's development.

With this update, players could now unleash the imperial powers of House Corrino. Their faction bonuses, including the ability to gain Hegemony through Guild Fees and manipulate Landsraad resolutions with the Imperial Edict, introduced numerous new ways to approach the game and vy for domination over your opponents. House Corrino also boasted a distinct roster of Councillors and units, each with their own special abilities and advantages.

The "House Corrino Update" expanded the diplomatic landscape by revamping diplomacy mechanics, introducing binary relations, and enhancing treaty systems. The AI was upgraded to better adapt to these changes, making for a more engaging and challenging experience.

And alongside all of that, the update brought significant improvements to the overall gameplay experience. It featured reworks of existing systems, the addition of new developments, and various quality-of-life enhancements. The CHOAM Market, Hegemony changes, and economic adjustments were among the notable additions, creating a richer and more immersive world on Arrakis.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/25e7724f746f1b1a22483a4be20acedc27f98ecf.png[/img]

The [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1605220/announcements/detail/3416569163136327034?snr=2_9_100003_]Accessibility Update[/url][/b] brought in a variety of accessibility options, including colorblind modes tailored for different types of colorblindness, and the ability to adjust the intensity of colorblind corrections. A magnifier feature was also introduced, allowing players to zoom in on specific areas of the game with customizable zoom multipliers. For those sensitive to certain visual stimuli, a photosensitive mode was included to remove flashes and reduce visual intensity in various game elements.

The Accessibility Update also addressed issues related to readability and user interface clarity. Players could now adjust chat text size and opacity, enhancing the overall readability of in-game communications. Additionally, an overlay system was introduced to help distinguish between ally, enemy, and personal units, providing greater clarity on the battlefield.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/e1a09c875758ac8259d87a3971cea7a0f597b620.png[/img]

The [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1605220/announcements/detail/5023230335810476688?snr=2_9_100003_]Air and Sand[/url][/b] update introduced a variety of exciting additions. Aerial combat was introduced and each faction acquired two new spaceship units, allowing even more strategic options. 

New resources, Guild Favors and Machine Scrap, added depth to gameplay. A revamped projectiles system improved the overall battle visuals, while The Renegades, a new neutral enemy faction, introduced a new challenge to be faced on the sands in order to earn valuable Guild Favors. 

Exclusive major buildings like the Spacing Guild Branch and Recycling Plant gave players new advantages. AI and multiplayer received improvements, while quality-of-life enhancements were introduced to improve the overall experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/34cafdf2dcb72f411edd6f5bc1d604d4598aedb5.png[/img]

In the [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1605220/announcements/detail/3662023588078631835?snr=2_9_100003_]Line in the Sand update[/url][/b] for 'Dune: Spice Wars,' we introduced significant game-wide improvements to enhance the experience and answer the requests of our community once again, with the addition of end-game statistics for evaluating your performance and the history of the game, more visible military alerts, and the ability for military units to hold their positions being some major additions.

Economic adjustments were made, such as increased Plascrete production with Solari upkeep, reduced manpower cost for Harvesters Crew, and balanced starting resources. Hegemony gains were shifted away from votes on resolutions, focusing more on spice contracts and gradual gains from the Emperor Monument.

The military side saw some significant changes in unit command points, expanded aura ranges, and reworked Fremen units specializing in debuffs. The supply system was simplified, dividing units into mechanical and non-mechanical categories, leading to various ability adjustments.

Spaceships, gear, village traits, and buildings all underwent balancing and changes. Spying operations were reworked, and developments saw modifications in knowledge generation. New regions, events, and Landsraad improvements added depth to the gameplay, rounding out the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/da8f2083cdba8a71f5c170d769a13c1ddc0bf8a1.jpg[/img]

The [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1605220/announcements/detail/3680051300624700227?snr=2_9_100003_]Conquest Update[/url][/b] finally saw the introduction of the much requested campaign mode to Dune: Spice Wars!

As they took charge of one of Dunes major houses (Atreides, Harkonnen, or Corrino) players would have to fight through a number of unique scenarios and situations in order to stand victorious as the ruler of Arrakis! With Conquest, each map is randomly generated, customizable perks create unique play styles and each playthrough offers a different experience and challenges to overcome in every run.

In addition, Tutorials were introduced to teach the game's basics, and factions, characters, and economics were heavily rebalanced. The political landscape shifted with changes to Landsraad Standing and treaties, and the CHOAM Market received new bonuses and a Nuclear Silo was added for the more warmonger-y among us.

Spying missions and operations were rebalanced, units were improved, and map generation was enhanced. The user interface received updates, including a new developments window and victory progression cards.

The update also delivered nine new music tracks and introduced numerous bug fixes.

[quote]And with all that now behind us, there's only one update left to go before we launch out of Early Access! Introducing House Ecaz, new tutorials, major system overhauls, improvements, and a ton more, we can assure you that the 1.0 update is going to have been worth the wait!

Thank you all for joining us on this journey. Developing the game alongside you all has been an incredible experience and we can't wait to hear your thoughts when the game launches into 1.0 this Thursday.

See you then...

- Shiro Games[/quote]

notes.title: Introducing: House Ecaz
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/456bf49ad831f26bbecc6ecd4e34c6d8b728d719.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/01d07b60a73e05bf9ff00d90ef5343cb55032ae4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/2636b50abc32f14761630bc0cfc263704b42a8ea.gif[/img]

 The refined and prestigious House Ecaz, patron of the finest artists, and master of every and all pleasures is formally inviting you to the inauguration of their newest resort: the exotic Arrakis.

Historical ally of House Atreides, this great house will fend for themselves on the harsh planes of Arrakis, that will, without doubt, become the crown jewel of the interplanetary archduchy under their rule.

Archduchess Armanda Ecaz and her family will bring their subtle blend of overt luxury, passive aggression, and political mastery to an already over-contested Dune, which will assuredly throw a wrench into whatever plans the other factions may have cooked up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/7e207e1bad851f1fd181095e770a27f31a99e05c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/e82161ca39796b491fa539b83ed92c49aa1027d6.jpg[/img]

Archduchess Armanda Ecaz is a refined, formidable lady. One who is not easily satisfied, and knows how to get what she wants. Her political acumen is not to be underestimated: at the head of one of the most powerful Houses in the galaxy, she managed to navigate several crises that could have been the end of her house, with relatively little loss. While most perceive her as a ruthless and dry woman, it’s not unheard of for her to display affection and warmth towards those who have proven to be her friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/105f4a01bea323aefc64959f9857197c5fa79dfb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/1b14202640bafa5267bc8b833b12f5faf1e359d5.gif[/img]

House Ecaz uses their connections with the world of art to disgrace and demoralise their opponents. They build Masterpieces, which while little more than glorified paperweights, cannot be destroyed without angering both the Landsraad and the locals.

They also make extra efforts to preserve local culture by raising sanctuaries surrounded by their own villages that cannot be captured, increasing their claim and territory on the planet. Building a Garden Resort in the middle of multiple sanctuaries will increase benefits even further.

House Ecaz are no pacifists, either. The pride and sense of honor of Ecazi soldiers is legendary. Their Champion units increase in strength upon being bestowed the title and bask in glory with every kill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/8a9801c0205f2853b4a3fae6a8c677f7100e143b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/cb8efeb258458921d7f1b5544de56c91eafafb11.png[/img]

As for most great houses, family plays a key role in the House Ecaz administration. Armanda's beloved daughters all have a key role to play in the house leadership.

[list]
[*] [b]Sanya Ecaz[/b] is the eldest daughter of Armanda, and current heir to the Ecaz dynasty. Her charming personality and eclectic tastes allow her to thrive among the artistic community of the house.
[*] [b]Whitmore Bludd[/b] was a renowned instructor at the Ginaz swordmaster school. After the fall of Ginaz, he entered the service of House Ecaz, first as Ilesa's bodyguard, and then as warmaster.
[*] [b]Ilesa Ecaz[/b] is the second daughter of Armanda. Having barely survived an assassination attempt at the onset of adulthood, Ilesa has grown into a bitter and serious woman, with no qualms about using her infirmity to guilt people into doing her bidding.
[*] [b]Mesa Ecaz[/b] is the youngest daughter of Armanda. She is driven and smart, always trying to encourage the use of house resources toward supporting and benefiting the people.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/d663bafb8cef0e5e355d4b7b31eab7e4a44f2736.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/31e02c284a02edfaac78be30229c681213d06ce9.png[/img]

Warfare is a rite of passage for the lower Ecazi nobility, who pride themselves on their bravery and honour. As such, most of the Ecazi army is organised around putting their best units in the most favourable light, winning decisive fights, with flair and style.

Their unique units include:
 
[list]
[*] [b]Squires:[/b] Armoured pikemen who have sworn to serve House Ecaz. They are used to taking the biggest blows from enemy forces, and focus on softening defences for stronger units to steal the show. 
[*] [b]Musketeers:[/b] Big-game hunters equipped with heavy muskets. They can take down even the most armoured enemies.
[*] [b]Fencers:[/b] Expert martial artists armed with elegant swords. They engage backline units in duels that they are sure to win.
[*] [b]War Banners:[/b] A floating reminder of everything House Ecaz stands for. The banner emboldens Ecazi soldiers and demoralises their enemy.
[*] [b]Knights:[/b] Ecazi nobility demonstrate their bravery, by joining the fray with a long sword and the support of all of their subordinates.
[/list]

[quote] House Ecaz will embroil themselves in the fight for Arrakis when Dune: Spice Wars leaves Early Access and enters 1.0 this September! 

Don't forget to keep an eye on our socials to stay up to date with everything related to Dune: Spice Wars' impending 1.0 release...

- Shiro Games[/quote]

notes.title: Conquest Update | Available Now!
notes.content:
[quote]Hello Everyone! The Update you've all been waiting for has finally arrived, as Conquest mode is now available in Dune Spice Wars!

Choose your house, chart your course, prepare your strategy and don't underestimate the countless perilous obstacles that may threaten your claim for Dominance over Arrakis...

Conquest mode, new tutorials, resource management updates and countless more changes lie ahead in the biggest update to Dune: Spice Wars yet, check out the full changelist [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LOwlJxOl1-0WhCfDtR5rmxcoiG30G8nzNREUZxs6Ch4/edit?usp=sharing]HERE[/url] or read on for a summary of what to expect![/quote]

[previewyoutube=DTYSMjueY4E;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Conquest Mode[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/193b9cec37250c689443f00c21590affe23631cd.jpg[/img]

Designed to be highly replayable, challenging and progression driven, Conquest is the campaign fans have been asking for since we released into Early Access at the start of last year.

In Conquest, players take up the control of one of the major houses (Atreides, Harkonnen or Corrino) and fight through a number of unique scenarios and situations that will encourage you to utilize every system at your disposal in order to progress.

You will be able to modify your house with a variety of perks that will result in more interesting ways to tackle the many challenging objectives Conquest throws at you and ensure a unique experience every time you play.

Each Conquest run provides around 10 hours of playtime, with no two runs being alike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/04201ff9c08422b94e037ae2406f2937fcdbfb7d.jpg[/img]

And Conquest mode will also see new missions, environments, scenarios and more added over time!
[h1]Tutorials[/h1]
Added 5 tutorials to learn the basics of the game:
[olist]
[*]Basic Controls
[*]Exploration
[*]Siege & Expansion
[*]Spice Harvesting
[*]Water & Upkeep
[/olist]
[h1]Factions[/h1]
Changed a number of Harkonnen, Smuggler and Corrino bonuses.

Reworked: Rabban, Feyd-Rautha, Staban, Bannerjee, Lingar, Mother Ramallo, Stilgar, Aramsham, Irulan and Fenring.


[h1]Economy[/h1]
[b]Solari:[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced all Solari gains and costs
[*] Economies are generally tighter with less gigantic productions in late game
[*] Economic specialization is less mandatory
[*] More focus on Spice
[/list]
[b]Plascrete and Fuel Cells rework:[/b]
[b]Plascrete rework:[/b]
[list]
[*] All Plascrete upkeeps have been removed
[*] Plascrete factories produce 10 Plascrete and have 20 Solari upkeep
[*] Plascrete costs have been changed to accommodate
[/list]
[b]Fuel Cells rework:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fuel Cells are now a “strategic resource”
[*] Fuel Cell Factories can only be built on Geothermal Energy and Great Volcano
[*] Refineries, Ornithopters and Airfields no longer cost Fuel Cells
[*] Major Buildings now cost Fuel Cells
[*] Factions start the game with 0 Fuel Cells
[/list]


[h1]Buildings[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/4c920826ab352262c47fadc2c4a99c967450bf96.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Every faction now has a new unique Village Building
[*] New economic Village Building: Wholesale Market, which produces a small amount of Solari
[*] New Major buildings and rework of old ones.
[*] Main Base buildings have been slightly streamlined and reworked.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/1f0905a491dce946397e68919fd0281c83587c5f.png[/img]
[h1]Hegemony[/h1]
[list]
[*] Victory is at 30 000 Hegemony.
[*] Craft workshop can now be built on any special region, and only on special regions
[*] Balancing
[/list]
[h1]Politics[/h1]
[list]
[*] All regular Landsraad Standing gains now happen at the end of a Landsraad session
[*] Treaties effects have been changed
[*] Charters don’t need to be unlocked anymore (only need eligibility)
[*] Many new and improved Resolutions
[/list]
[h1]CHOAM Market[/h1]
[list]
[*] New bonuses when you own 10% and 30% CHOAM shares
[*] New Auto-buy and Auto-sell toggle
[/list]
[h1]Nuclear Silo [b](New)[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/2ccb3c9f8803b9667050f7bab1e7d6340d8fb2ae.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Nukes have been reworked
[*] Nukes now need to be produced in the new “Nuclear Silo” Major Building before being launched
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/f6966fc407d60862def4fb51609ebac219052158.jpg[/img]
[h1]Spying[/h1]
[list]
[*] Spying mission balancing
[*] New agent slots can be acquired by putting an infiltration cell in their territory with a new operation
[*] Added sacrifice and hastened shortcuts for operation quick slots in the right bar
[/list]
[b]Full Assassination rework:[/b]
[list]
[*] Assassination is a regular mission that can be launched on an opponent’s territory
[*] Once the operation is launched, a countdown to assassination appears that both the target and the assassin can interact with
[*] New diplomatic action “Guarantee of safety” can be put in a trade to put an end to the current assassination attempt
[/list]
[h1]Units[/h1]
A number of QoL changes and improvements to overall game feel
[b]Harkonnen:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/9eac8a5c07250f619a642719aaa573e8050e7df6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Swapped Cerberus and Executioner tier
[*] Cerberus: New model with a more polished behavior and look. The split now triggers once the original unit dies
[*] Executioner: Is now an Elite unit, they stack health regen and power with nearby deaths
[/list]
[b]Fremen:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mobile turret: Can now attack from range in roaming form and can only attack air units once deployed. More polished look and transition between deploy states.
[*] Deployable Units:
[*] Now have a deployment time. 
[/list]
[b]Assassins:[/b]
[list]
[*] Can no longer attack mechanical units.
[/list]
[h1]Map[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/9b3b45d9763d3b1681584ef05223161c947b29e5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New Region: Sandfall
[*] Improved map generation
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] New developments window
[*] Added victory progression cards that spawn when a faction is close to victory
[*] Added a “Victory screen” button to the pause menu after finishing a game to view game stats again
[/list]
[h1]Music[/h1]
[list]
[*] 9 new tracks
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
Many bug fixes, most notable ones:
[list]
[*] Attacks on buildings can now be shift queued
[*] Using the Spice slider will no longer trigger border scroll
[*] Fixed unstartable Spying Missions
[*] Fixed aggressive units attacking truced players
[/list]

[quote]Thank you all for your patience while we worked on this update, it's been a long time coming but we can assure you, it was worth the wait!

Enjoy the update and stay tuned for news about what's next for Dune: Spice Wars!

- Shiro Games[/quote]

notes.title: Dune: Spice Wars | April Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/77907744941e4cfdf2f08b0d4c59a0f261fa66a6.png[/img]

[quote]Hello everyone!

It's now been a year since we released into Early Access and a while since we drew back the curtains on how Spice Wars' development is coming along, so in this article we're gonna do exactly that!

Read on for some insights into what's been going on behind the scenes here at Shiro Games, and what you can expect over the coming months in Dune: Spice Wars...
[/quote]

[h1]It's been a while since the last update, what's going on? [/h1]

Well, with all of the support, feedback and help our community has afforded us since launch, we needed to make sure that what we were developing and planning to bring to the game was decided with their expectations, hopes and suggestions firmly in mind. 

With that, we have made some adjustments to the development plan, which meant that the next update would be the most significant and substantial one yet (more specific details on that further down the article) and pushed back some of the more "good to have, but not urgent" developments that we originally had in mind. 

Obviously, such a change in course can have a bit of a domino effect, as we've seen with the recent lack of updates but we're confident that our community will be thrilled with the result!

[h1]So what are we working on at the moment? [/h1]

Well, quite frankly, a ton of stuff! But for the cliff notes:

[b]Conquest:[/b] [i]A brand new campaign![/i] 

Development is well underway and it's looking fantastic, we'll have a bunch of stuff to share on this mode very soon, but for now, the small write up in the next section will have to suffice.

[b]Tutorials:[/b] [i]Time to learn the ropes![/i] 

Players have been requesting a more straightforward introduction to the game and a better explanation of the many systems and mechanics at play since it dropped last year and we're very happy to announce that the game will soon see the introduction of a full set of tutorials that will accomplish exactly this and see new players well on their way to conquering Arrakis in no time! 

[i]Here's an early look at the Tutorial menu and a couple of the tutorials you can expect to see upon it's release (there are only 4 at this stage, with more in the works to be ready for the mode's launch)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/90f76eee64f6982d9413c17029b6fc68dc7c15ca.png[/img]

[b]A new faction:[/b] [i]No Spoilers, stay tuned...[/i]

Let's round this dry, sandy party out with a brand new sixth faction. But who might it be...?

[b]Game customisation:[/b] [i]Play your way![/i] 

We're implementing a number of new game customisation options so that players will be able to adjust various different settings before each game, including world hostility, overall difficulty, the amount of taxes they pay, and more...

[b]Heroes of Dune:[/b] [i]Hero characters are coming to Dune: Spice Wars![/i] 

We're still relatively early in the development process here after the release of conquest was brought forward, but we've got some great ideas and some even more fantastic concepts already fully formed! 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[i](Keep in mind that not everything above will be releasing in one update however, this is just a look at what we're either currently working on actively or have in the pipeline right now)[/i]

[h1]What is Conquest Mode?[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/7968d57b86be11df5160dfd6d9cdd39c632950d4.png[/img]

Designed to be highly replayable, challenging and progression driven, Conquest will act as Dune: Spice Wars' "campaign".  

In Conquest, players will take up the control of one of the major houses and fight through number of unique scenarios and situations that will encourage the player to utilise every system at their disposal in order to progress. As players progress through the mode, they will be able to modify their starting house with a variety of perks and upgrades that will result in more interesting ways to tackle the many challenging objectives Conquest throws at them and ensure a unique experience every time they play. 

The goal of this mode is to encourage and reward players for experimenting with different playstyles, allow the player to develop interesting, diverse and unique builds over the course of each of their runs and make full use of the various systems available in Dune: Spice Wars to channel the core themes of the series and immerse the player even further into this rich and iconic universe. 

Each Conquest run will provide around 10 hours of playtime, with no two runs being alike and we're happy to share that this update, is coming up next!

[h1]How much longer will the game be in Early Access?[/h1]

Right now, we're at about 70% of what's planned for the game, with the above additions probably rounding that out to about 95% with balancing, map generation improvements and system overhauls also in the works that should bring us to 100% and ultimately, release! 

So while there's still a lot of work to do, we're targetting a release out of Early Access towards the latter half of the year and we'll keep you all in the loop on this front as we move through the roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/1a790582c4934756271d561fe8e164f4a0d40cea.png[/img]

[quote]Don’t hesitate to drop any questions you might have in the discussions and as always, thank you all for your support!

Shiro Games[/quote]

notes.title: "Line In The Sand" Community Update | Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41624136/fb44be6bdb7424a84873a50c8d38b026be28655a.png[/img]

[quote]Hey Everyone!

The Line In The Sand update is available now for Dune: Spice Wars!

This update introduces a number of changes, additions and balancing work based around the feedback and suggestions of our players over the last few months, alongside some major additions and improvements we’ve had cooking up since we launched into Early Access last year. 

The Line In The Sand update is a substantial update addressing numerous aspects of the game, so let’s check out what you can expect with the full changelist below...[/quote]

[h1]Main Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added End Game Statistics
[*]Military alerts now appear on the border of the screen pointing in the direction of the crisis
[*]Military units can now Hold their Position (With C)
[*]Fremen Harvesting Teams can now harvest Spice in neutral territories
[*]Map Generation improvements:
[list]
[*]Main Bases and Deep Desert spawning has changed to make maps that are both more fair and varied
[*]Changed Spice spawn to ensure less spiceless starts
[/list]
[*]Military balancing
[*]Major performance improvements and optimization
[/list]
[h1]Economy[/h1]
[list]
[*]Plascrete factories produce more Plascrete but have a Solari upkeep
[*]Harvesters Crew cost less Manpower
[*]Balanced starting Ressources
[*]Pillage gains nerfed but increased by the number of buildings on the targeted Village
[*]UHQ Buildings have no Solari upkeep
[*]Nerfed Guild Favor gain from Events and Discoveries
[/list]
[h1]Hegemony[/h1]
[list]
[*]No more gain from votes on resolution
[*]More gain from paying your spice contract
[*]Balanced Hegemony for Small and Large maps
[*]Emperor Monument now gives hegemony over time instead of instantly
[/list]
[h1]Military[/h1]
[list]
[*]Units now cost more Command Points
[*]Auras range increased
[*]Rework of Fremen units: They are now specialized in putting debuffs on their opponents
[*]Supply:
[list]
[*]Reworked the Supply system to be easier to read and handle
[*]Units regenerate less Supply in occupied villages
[/list]
[*]Units are now divided in two types:
[list]
[*]Mechanical (Drones, Ships and Frigates)
[*]Non-Mechanical (Humanoids)
[/list]
[*]These types lead to the following changes:
[list]
[*]Atreides Healing drone now only heals non-mechanical units
[*]Harkonnen 5K Hegemony bonus now only works upon killing non-mechanical units
[*]Harkonnen Combat Drugs and Toxic Vapors now only affect non-mechanical units
[*]Harkonnen Sleeper Agents now only procs with non-mechanical units
[*]Bannerjee Health regen now only works for non-mechanical units
[*]Supply drop now only affects non-mechanical units
[/list]
[*]Demo effects now only apply on their ranged attacks (Wreckers Contamination, Heavy [*]Weapon Squads Disruption…)
[*]Harkonnen Stealth Probes only give their buff to nondrones
[*]Harkonnen Gunners: Damage ally units → Reduce healing of damaged units by 50%
[*]Idle Sleeper Agents and Unchained Cerberus are now aggressive
[*]Units firing projectiles are now considered "in combat" as soon as they fire
[*]Units with camouflage now lose it upon firing projectiles instead of losing it once the projectile hits
[/list]
[b]Kraken:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now gains power for each transported units
[*]Base power has been rebalanced
[/list]
[b]Overlord:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stings are now only deployed when the Overlord attacks and are then aggressive towards any enemy
[*]When out of combat, the Overlord now retrieves its Stings if they are no longer attacking anyone
[*]Stings are considered low priority by missile batteries and main bases
[*]Stings are more spread out 
[*]Stings considered as Drone
[*]New ability: Decimation protocol, boosts Stings generation speed and increases damage of nearby drones and stings but damages them over time
[/list]
[b]Wraith:[/b]
[list]
[*]Damages were based on current Health and did an additional 1 damage per tick, it is now 1% max Health per second as stated
[/list]
[b]Cronos:[/b]
[list]
[*]New ability: Can be deployed to be used as an airfield
[/list]
[b]Smugglers Combat Drone rework:[/b] 
[list]
[*] The Scavenging Drone gathers loot from the fallen and distributes it to ally units in the form of Power and Armor
[/list]
[b]Rework of landsraad units:[/b]
[list]
[*]Landsraad guards are melee units that receive reduced damage from low Standing factions. They are granted by a resolution or a development
[*]Landsraad Judges are focus range units that deal increased damage to low Standing factions. They can be trained by the holder of “Judge of the Council”
[*]Landsraad Punishers are demo units that deal increased damage to Main Bases of low Standing factions. They are granted by a resolution
[*]All three units participate in Landsraad Raids against Pariah
[/list]
[b]Neutral raids:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now move in a more compact group and act in unison. They should no longer separate due to different pathing. They should also be harder to distract from their main target
[/list]
[h1]Gear[/h1]
[b]New Gear:[/b]
[list]
[*]Free Company: Dual Guns (Becomes ranged)
[*]Cerberus: Dual Swords (More damages)
[*]Gunners: Gatling Gun (High attack speed, no longer demo)
[*]Wreckers: Bazookas (More range)
[*]Stealth Probes: Mounted Explosives (Explode on death)
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Incinerators: Better Fuel Pumps: Increased range 30 → 50%, now correctly impact the range of the area damage and changes flames FX accordingly
[/list]
[h1]Villages[/h1]
[b]New Village traits:[/b]
[list]
[*]Local Sourcing: 20 Solaris production when the village has at least one Building of each type
[*]Versatile: +10% production when the village has at least one Building of each type
[/list]
[h1]Buildings[/h1]
[list]
[*]Recruitment Office: Produces more Manpower
[*]Listening Post: Not stackable anymore, gives +1 Influence even if neighboring more than 1 enemy regions
[/list]
[h1]Main Base[/h1]
[b]Bazaar: [/b]
[list]
[*]Added a new effect: In a completed district now also gives the district bonus of the previous level of the same type (ex: Bazaar and 2 economic buildings in a level 3 district give both level 3 and level 2 economic district bonus)
[/list]
[b]Emperor Monument:[/b]
[list]
[*]Doubles every district bonus in the Main Base it’s built in, instead of doubling traits for adjacent villages
[/list]
[h1]Sietches[/h1]
[list]
[*]New bonuses when allied
[/list]
[h1]Spying[/h1]
[b]New Operations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Defense Sabotage (New): Reduce power of enemy missile batteries and Main Base
[*]EMP Bomb: Reduce power and speed of enemy mechanical units and missile batteries
[*]Defense Breaches: Increase damage taken by enemy Main Base
[*]Fremen Sabotage (Fremen only): Reduce enemy power and speed
[/list]
[b]Removed Operations:[/b]
[list]
[*]Defense Sabotage (Old)
[*]Gear Sabotage
[*]Sand Cloak (Fremen only)
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed Missions duration
[*]Easy missions don’t cost Solaris anymore
[*]Changed some mission difficulty level and cost
[*]Supply Drop no longer affects mechanical Units
[*]Agent Sacrifice removed from certain Missions (Nukes, Assassinations)
[*]Arrakis Diplomacy now also disbands Renegade raids and Rebels. Sietch in the affected region no longer gain relationships, but increased resources from trade
[*]Awake the People now boosts Rebels
[*]Communication Jamming now removes all active Operations
[/list]
[h1]Developments[/h1]
[b]Balanced Knowledge generation: [/b]
[list]
[*]District 1 bonus now gives +30% completion speed in the relevant developments, instead of +50%
[*]Research Center: now gives +2 knowledge, +20% Knowledge and 20% Research hub upkeep, instead of +3, +30% and 30%
[*]Research Hubs: now have 16 solaris upkeep, instead of 10
[/list]
[h1]Regions[/h1]
[b]New Regions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Space Cruiser Wreck
[*]Mountains
[/list]
[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Acid lake and Desolation damage now only affects ground units
[*] Equatorial Regions can now have 7 Wind
[/list]
[h1]Events[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some Events have been reworked to be more involving
[/list]
[h1]Landsraad[/h1]
[list]
[*] Landsraad bar with segments (Work In Progress), indicating the different landsraad phases relevant to the player
[*] Landsraad button now blinks harder when you have an action available in the landsraad screen.
[*] Landsraad UI now displays other Faction's Influence
[*] Base max influence is heavily reduced
[*] High levels of Landsraad standing now give max influence
[*]  AI now spend vote and influence by increment of 10, with the same restrictions as the player
[/list]
[h1]Diplomacy[/h1]
[list]
[*] Truce now generates 0.2 standing or 1 influence per day for both sides
[*] Truces now have a small grace window during which any attack will be ignored for the good of the treaty (this should prevent truces from being instantly canceled when they are enacted in the middle of a fight)
[*] Entering a truce did not cancel queued attack actions and the alerts of canceled actions did not target the right entity
[*] Political agreement no longer prevents voting for the other side on negative resolutions
[*] Abilities with diplomatic restrictions will now cancel themselves when diplomatic statuses change
[/list]
[h1]Councilors[/h1]
[b]Some councilors have been reworked:[/b]
[list]
[*] Thufir Hawat can Hasten any village building or mission to fasten its installation time. He still gives a second trait to any agent.
[*] Duncan Idaho gives the trait Loyal to villages after a peaceful annex which gives many bonuses.
[*] Iakin Nefud base cost refund for military units is now 30%. He also prevents units from leveling up, giving a further refund bonus instead.
[*] Piter de Vries no longer improves Ornithopters. They still improve the stealth drone. They also give further incentive to put a few agents on faction infiltration.
[*] Drisq now has stealth ornithopters, on top of all other bonuses.
[*] Staban Tuek gives Solaris through adjacent underworld headquarters, and by resolving discoveries.
[*] Mother Ramallo now reduces production on neighboring enemy villages on top of other bonuses.
[*] Otheym now reduce damage received by isolated unit, instead of increasing armor
[*] Chani’s Incite Rebellion does not prevent Fremen from voting for the targeted resolution anymore.
[*] Stilgar produce authority for each spice field within your territory, and increase production in region containing an allied Sietch
[*] Wensicia can build 1 more of every village building, but increases upkeep of buildings that are not duplicated.
[*] Aramsham reduces all cost and upkeep of Conscript by 25%, but reduces their power and health by 15%. He also gives one recruitment slot.
[*] Irulan’s Development investment can now only be used on Villages in Truce. It can be turned on or off, with an upkeep, instead of having to start it again constantly.
[/list]
[h1]AI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked the military decisions engine
[*] Added unit micro management in combat
[*] Fremen AI can now use Worm Riding
[*] Small improvements and fixes in general
[/list]
[h1]QoL[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added AoE preview on Units
[*] Attack orders now continue when the target is dead and units will go to the target's dying position
[*] Units with a deploy system now correctly undeploy to move when they are asked to attack out of their range
[*] Harvesters now have to wait for the Sandworm attack to be finished to redeploy
[*] Improved russian translation with the prepositional plural form
[*] Some units using rocket launchers now fire visible missiles
[*] Units refund amounts from the Iakin passive are now displayed in the world similarly to looting effects
[*] Units now have quotes on certain abilities
[/list]
[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added sound effects to some gear and spying operation.
[*] Added voices to unit abilities where it was missing
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Alerts are a bit bigger, and wiggle more
[*] All timed traits now show their duration left in their tooltip
[*] Added statuses on Ornithopters that are escorting Harvesters and Units
[*] Double clicking a unit portrait in the right bar now selects all units of this type, regardless of whether they are in view, instead of focusing the unit (which can still be done with right click)
[*] Transported units portraits can now be interacted with
[*] Current game settings are visible in the ingame menu
[*] Game Settings new UI style
[*] Main menu visual changes
[*] Irulan's Development Investment now displays predicted and current gains on the tooltip
[*] Added alerts upon a successful pillage
[*] Removed eligible factions from Governorship notification
[*] Added Units move speed in their Health tooltip
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Neutral units could not be targeted directly by sandworms (they could get eaten but not be the actual target of the worm so raids would never get eaten by themselves for instance)
[*] Some missile attacks showed an additional one with a weird trajectory on clients
[*]Decimals in units power resulted in rounded damage, this is no longer the case
[*]Actions queues were not correctly wiped in some instances (Attacking a unit now correctly works with queues, the unit will go to the next action once the targeted unit is dead)
[*] Fixed Ornithopters wrongly detected as idle
[*] Fixed Shuttle ability not appearing in groups containing a ship
[*] Fixed ranged attacks that sometimes did not play effects when firing units in the air
[*] Hid resupply UI on unrecconned Villages
[*] Fixed combat between neutral Factions
[*] Banners should no longer show up in fog right after a Unit spawned
[*] Fixed unlimited pause softlocking the game if the player that paused disconnects
[*] Fixed votes not being multiples of 10
[*] Fixed issues with resupplying near villages and bugged interactions with the smugglers 5k Hegemony
[*] Fixed victory type achievements, they are no longer attributed to team members (example: winning a CHOAM victory only gives the achievement to the CHOAM winner, not his teammates)
[*] Removed reposition phase to prevent Mobile Turrets from never attacking and all Units clamping up on the village before starting the fight which caused delays
[*] Spying UI no longer wraps if the resource is too long
[*] Fixed some situations where villages would be incorrectly considered in siege
[*] Fixed some crashes upon loading old saves
[*] Fixed disappearance of some ships FXs
[*] Fixed reactivity issues on the Developments window
[/list]
[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*]7 New Achievements
[*] Added helper tips to loading screen (can be turned off in settings)
[*] Corrino base units are now named Conscript Swordsman & Conscript Rifleman
[/list]
